Test Bancorp Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

Reported diluted EPS of $1.27; adjusted EPS of $1.39, excluding notable items of $(0.12) per share, primarily a $110 million securities repositioning loss.

Net interest income of $1,834 million increased 2% from the prior quarter; net interest margin (FTE) of 3.12%, up 4 basis points.

The company repurchased $250 million of common stock during the quarter.

The company now expects full-year 2026 net interest income growth of 3% to 4%.
